testCases.name: Customer Aggregate With Fuzzy Fields
testCases.input: BoundedContext CustomerManagement { domain { Aggregate Customer { customerId is uuid and identity. text fullName can not null. emailAddress is text email required. optional phoneNumber text. createdAt datetime immutable. } } }

testCases.name: Address Value Object Normalization
testCases.input: BoundedContext Shipping { domain { ValueObject Address { street text required, city is string not null, postalCode text maximum length 20, countryCode text exactly 2 chars, apartment can be null text. } } }

testCases.name: Product Entity With Numeric Constraints
testCases.input: BoundedContext Catalog { domain { Entity Product { productId uuid primary key. name text is mandatory. sku string unique. price decimal minimum 0. stock integer cannot be below 0. active boolean. } } }

testCases.name: Money Value Object
testCases.input: BoundedContext Payments { domain { ValueObject Money { amount decimal and must be at least 0. currency text required max 3 chars. } } }

testCases.name: Appointment Aggregate Dates
testCases.input: BoundedContext Scheduling { domain { Aggregate Appointment { appointmentId uuid identity. patientName text can not null. scheduledAt datetime required. durationMinutes integer min 15 max 240. notes optional text. } } }

testCases.name: Domain Event Fields
testCases.input: BoundedContext Notifications { events { DomainEvent EmailQueued { eventId uuid identity-like value, recipient is email text required, subject text required, queuedAt datetime required, retryCount int minimum 0. } } }

testCases.name: Repository Method Normalization
testCases.input: BoundedContext Catalog { domain { Aggregate Product { productId uuid identity. name text required. active boolean. } } repositories { ProductRepository for Product with methods: find by id takes UUID id and returns optional Product; find active returns list of Product; save product returns nothing. } }
